sun.meaning: You are built for consistency: slow to start, nearly impossible to stop, with an unteachable instinct for what feels good and lasts. Change is fine, as long as it was your idea and arrived on schedule.

planets.signLine: In Taurus, it takes on a fixed earth style. Steady hands, good taste, and a long memory for comfort.
In Taurus, it takes on a fixed earth style. Steady hands, good taste, and a long memory for comfort.
In Pisces, it takes on a mutable water style. Porous, imaginative, tuned to what goes unspoken.
In Cancer, it takes on a cardinal water style. Feels first, remembers everything, protects what it loves.
In Capricorn, it takes on a cardinal earth style. Patient, ambitious, building something that lasts.

aspects.line: Your Mars has an open line to your Uranus. A change of method can restore momentum when effort stalls. Test a different tool or approach before simply pushing harder.
Your Sun is fused to your Mercury. The self and its narrator share a desk, which makes the account vivid and the distance between you and your own opinions small.
Your Mercury runs downhill into your Neptune. Your way of thinking and your imagination help each other so smoothly the gift is easy to miss.

Your Sun runs downhill into your Neptune. Imagination and empathy can become natural ways of expressing yourself. Give them a medium, and keep time for your own wishes alongside what you absorb from others.
Your Neptune has an open line to your Pluto. Your imagination and your intensity cooperate whenever you remember to ask.
Your Mars runs downhill into your Jupiter. Your drive and your appetite for more help each other so smoothly the gift is easy to miss.
Your Jupiter faces off with your Uranus. Your appetite for more and your independence hold opposite ends of one axis, taking turns unless you seat them both.
Your Mercury faces off with your Pluto. Your way of thinking and your intensity hold opposite ends of one axis, taking turns unless you seat them both.

lines: Earth carries 6 of the ten planets. The chart is load-bearing: real things, on real timelines.
There is no planet in fire. Initiative is a practice here, not a reflex.
There is no planet in air. Distance from a question takes deliberate effort.
4 planets were retrograde when you were born, a chart that does much of its work on the second pass.
Saturn, Uranus, Neptune all sit in Capricorn, a stellium; that sign's agenda gets 3 votes.
